claim: L'Eau Vive sits at Route de Floreffe 37, 5170 Rivière (Profondeville); the property includes two guest accommodations, Le Cube (in the restaurant garden) and Espace Medissey (in Bois-de-Villers).
quote: Not sure where to stay after your meal at our gourmet restaurant? Consider our guesthouse near Namur in Bois-de-Villers, Medissey, or at Le Cube, our cottage located in the restaurant's garden by the river.

claim: Le Cube is a 150 m² cottage on two levels, sleeps 2–6 people, with 2 en-suite bedrooms (showers), living room with sofa-bed, equipped kitchen, suspended terrace, BBQ and private parking.
quote: Le Cube is a charming contemporary dwelling that borders the forest and the Burnot brook, measuring 150 m² across two levels and accommodating 2 to 6 people. It includes 2 en-suite rooms (showers), a living room with sofa bed, a fully equipped kitchen, a hanging terrace with garden furniture, barbecue, and private parking.

claim: Le Cube rates: €300/night for 2 people, €350/night for 4, +€100 per additional bed; breakfast €20/person delivered on request, excluding Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
quote: For one night: €300 for 2 people and €350 for 4 people. Additional bed costs €100 per day. Breakfast can be delivered on request (booking the day before) for 20€/person, excluding Tuesday and Wednesday and excluding restaurant annual leave.

claim: L'Eau Vive holds two Michelin stars; the Guide lists it under Arbre, Namur Province.
quote: L'Eau Vive - Arbre - Un restaurant du guide MICHELIN

claim: Espace Medissey is at Chemin des Seize Pieds 5, Bois-de-Villers; 5 rooms, $278–$352/night, with swimming pool, hot tub, fitness center, bike rental; rated 4.6/5 over 63 reviews; ~2.4 mi from L'Eau Vive.
quote: Chemin des Seize Pieds 5, Bois-De-Villers, Profondeville 5170, Belgium. 5 rooms. $278–$352 per night. Swimming pool and hot tub… Distance to L'Eau Vive: Approximately 2.4 miles away. 4.6 of 5 stars (63 reviews).

claim: Anne and Pierre Résimont built Espace Medissey in 2008 as contemporary guest rooms — the name fuses their two children's names (Mehdi and Issey) — and later added Le Cube, a glazed gîte a stone's throw from the restaurant.
quote: In 2008, Anne and Pierre Résimont built and opened contemporary rooms in the Medissey Space… Pierre Résimont recently created Le Cube, a stone's throw from the restaurant, also along the water, like a kind of gîte.
